svg.aria-label: Consilium and Consilium Plebis across training, each against the network it replaces
svg.text: Consilium and Consilium Plebis across training
Elo of epoch exports against the network each one replaces: Consilium against Legio Septima (time control), Consilium Plebis against Consilium (fixed 100k nodes)
Training epoch (pretraining P, then Consilium's F3 from 373)
Different references and conditions: read the shape, not the gap. Consilium Plebis: 37 points up to epoch 486, where its learning rate is 5% of the peak.
Consilium's later points (from epoch 157) use the evaluation scale calibrated per phase; its gain over Legio Septima arrived with the F3 fine-tune (+14.5 at 90+0.9).
